All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**1. Ticket created — DONE.** Ticket titled `fwrd10-n1 RD Bench Ticket` exists, ref **RD-1015**, initial status **Draft**. The create form only required the title field.

**2. Part A added — DONE.** Part `fwrd10-n1 RD Part A`, cost $100.00, markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**3. Part B added — DONE.** Part `fwrd10-n1 RD Part B`, cost $200.00, markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00**.

**4. Part A cost changed to 150 — DONE.** Cost updated to $150.00 (markup still 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket total at that point: $437.50.

**5. Status set to Ready — DONE.** Precondition discovered: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned**. The app refused the first "Mark Ready" attempt with the exact message: *"Ticket is not ready. Part 'fwrd10-n1 RD Part A' has no supplier. Part 'fwrd10-n1 RD Part B' has no supplier."* The supplier field is free-text in the part edit form; I assigned **ABC Supplies** to Part A and **XYZ Supplies** to Part B, after which "Mark Ready" was accepted and the ticket showed **Status: Ready**.

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE.** Both parts deleted; the parts table confirmed **"No parts on this ticket yet."** with 0 parts. "Archive ticket" succeeded (button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). Verified independently: RD-1015 does **not** appear in the default active tickets list (which shows RD-1014 down to RD-1004), and appears only when "Show archived" is checked, with an **Archived** badge, status **Ready**, 0 parts. Nothing created by this run remains active.
